template_extraction.body: Slice after the matching heading through before the next project/blind heading, or EOF; apply .strip("\n") + "\n".
template_extraction.rendering: Repeat 0: wrong then correct; repeat 1: correct then wrong. Substitute .strip() of each plan into {a} and {b}, in that order, using str.replace. Hash the rendered UTF-8 prompt as prompt_sha256.

historical_log_verification.case_selection: Require case_id and options_sha256 to match an entry in the frozen case manifest.
historical_log_verification.deduplication: Last row in file order per key; mirrors the report module's latest_only rule.
historical_log_verification.result: Every retained row matches the released template and rendered-prompt digests; zero mismatches.
historical_log_verification.scope: Verifies the recorded template and rendered-prompt digests of the retained runs against this snapshot. It does not independently establish complete session contents, tool configuration, system messages, or historical source code versions.
historical_log_verification.cohort: The final benchmark contains 248 cases with unchanged plans and prompts.

casewriter_verification.scope: Manifest-level agreement only; individual historical casewriter calls and instruction compliance were not independently verified.

privacy_scope: Only generic prompts and their verification metadata are included here. Personal source paths, filesystem timestamps, and internal release labels are omitted; prompt bytes, digests, verification counts, and verification limitations are preserved. No accounts, credentials, retained sessions, or raw research conversations are included.
release_note: Public copies of the case-writing prompt and the ask prompt are lightly genericized: internal system and role names, workspace repository names, and internal tool module paths were replaced with generic terms. Field meanings and instructions are unchanged. "internal_original_sha256" preserves the digest of the byte-exact internal original where the released copy differs.
